POSITIVE DETAILED-BALANCE BROADCASTING: A COLLECTIVE VARIANCE INTERFACE
AND DIMENSION-FREE POVM / BISTOCHASTIC-INSTRUMENT ROUNDING CLASSES
7 October 2026. Worker /root/matching_classicality_audit.

STATUS

The unrestricted fixed-sandwich broadcasting-to-EB implication is NOT
proved or disproved. No constant-error counterexample in the corrected
positive detailed-balance class was obtained. No finite solver result is
used as a theorem.

Concrete progress beyond the exact fixed-point argument:

1. An exact, dimension-independent equivalence between uniform EB
   reconstruction and a max-prior convex roof of JOINT pure-state variance.
   Its minimax is proved; the same measurement handles every label.

2. For an arbitrary POVM in an arbitrary finite tracial algebra, an explicit
   selfcompatible positive selfadjoint channel S=(L+Psi)/2, where L is its
   Luders update and Psi its canonical Petz-measurement EB channel, obeys

       0 <= Psi <= S <= I,
       I-Psi <= 2(I-S)                                      (A)

   as Hilbert-space operator inequalities. Hence bounded likelihoods with
   full-trace residual r admit ONE EB reconstruction of half-trace error

       e <= (1/2) sqrt(2 theta r).                          (B)

   A larger class starts from ANY supplied bistochastic Kraus instrument
   L, symmetrizes its actual instrument-append joint map to get common
   marginal C=(L+Psi)/2, and applies Petz recovery C* to BOTH outputs.
   Its positive marginal Phi=C*C admits I-Psi<=2(I-Phi), with the same
   error bound (B). No L selfadjointness, L positivity, or Psi<=Phi
   ordering is assumed for this larger class.

   Tensor products retain ANY fixed Dirichlet constant c>=1 for positive
   marginal and reconstruction maps. The proof requires neither a local
   Psi<=Phi ordering nor local commutation. Convex mixtures, direct sums
   and trace-preserving unitary conjugates retain the comparisons too.

3. A dimension-independent Holevo-continuity calculation validates the
   capacity part of the proposed many-output information-chain route, but
   isolates its missing measurement-to-trace step. Recent primary de
   Finetti papers do not supply that step under the present interface.

DETAILED-BALANCE BROADCASTING: AN EXACT EB DIRICHLET ROUNDING SUBCLASS
7 October 2026. Worker /root/large_clique_broadcast.

STATUS / STRONGEST RESULT

The general fixed-sandwich broadcasting=>EB theorem remains OPEN. I did not
construct a counterexample, prove a universal rounding theorem, or turn d>2
PPT feasibility into an EB claim.

Internally proved positive subclass: every positive Hilbert-Schmidt-selfadjoint
bistochastic selfcompatible QUBIT channel Phi admits an explicit positive
bistochastic selfadjoint EB channel Psi with

    0 <= Psi <= Phi,
    I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi)                                             (1)

as quadratic forms on the Hilbert-Schmidt operator space. The SAME constant
2 survives arbitrarily many tensor factors, convex mixtures, and simultaneous
input/output unitary conjugation. Depolarizing selfcompatible qudit factors
also satisfy (1). This gives a growing-Hilbert-dimension result that retains
arbitrarily slow classical modes, with no label-count or spectral-gap premise.
The constant 2 is sharp for the universal qubit cloner.

For any channel in this class and ANY experiment of states
rho=(I+H)/D, H=H*, ||H||<=theta, Tr H=0, with uniform full-trace residual
r=sup_rho ||Phi(rho)-rho||_1, ONE explicit EB map achieves

    e_EB(E) <= (1/2) sqrt(2 theta r).                              (2)

The same argument applies to weighted direct sums of block-preserving channels
from the class, using the faithful central trace. It does not cover arbitrary
channels mixing matrix blocks, arbitrary interacting channels, or arbitrary
selfcompatible channels in dimensions >2.

Let (A,tau) be a finite-dimensional C*-algebra with faithful normalized trace,
and let Phi be UCP, tau-preserving, positive and selfadjoint on L2(A,tau).
If there is a UCP tau-preserving positive selfadjoint EB Psi satisfying

NEW FRONTIER / RESUME WITHOUT REPEATING THE SURVEY
7 October 2026. Internal research; not externally reviewed.

The campaign has not established a field-breaking result. Two sharper open
mechanisms now sit beyond the verified internal transfers. Begin here, then
read their exact latest reports; do not silently strengthen imported results.

1. DETERMINANT-WEIGHTED LINEAR MATROID PARITY

For explicit complex rational F in C^(n x n), let
 c_k(F)=sum_{I,J disjoint, |I|=|J|=k} |det F[I,J]|^2.
This is the k-pair norm of a hard onsite-projected opposite-spin BCS state.
With f_i equal to the transpose of row i, V=[I,F^T], and P(I) selecting both
columns (e_i,f_i), Cauchy--Binet gives
 c_k(F)=sum_{|I|=k} det((V*V)[P(I)]).
Equivalently retain only exponents 0 or 2 in
 det(I+sum_i x_i(e_i e_i*+f_i f_i*)), then replace x_i^2 by z_i.

The scalar sum_k c_k z^k is real-rooted by the audited clone identity.
Support, exact zero detection and witnesses also have a deterministic
polynomial-bit reduction to the imported Hamada--Iwata unweighted linear
matroid-parity algorithm. Clear rational-complex denominators, bound the norm
of a nonzero Gaussian-integer minor, and test polynomially many finite fields;
one preserves an optimum witness and all modular witnesses lift soundly.
Forced-pair contraction and excluded-pair deletion handle prefixes. The
algorithmic import and reduction have not been implemented here. The earlier
randomized Pfaffian route remains valid. Neither supplies a counting oracle.

New target: a polynomial-bit relative norm/coefficient algorithm and acquired
conditional samples for this exact weighted parity class. An appropriate
worm/defect representation would extend conditional hard-projected-state
preparation beyond the bipartite pair-matrix subclass. All oracle, support,
coefficient range, balancing, precision and sample costs must be charged.
